cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: On-device math tutor for Nigerian CS undergraduates — covers Discrete Mathematics, Calculus I/II, and Linear Algebra via RAG over GSM8K/Hendrycks MATH/OpenStax corpus. Serves students at distance-learning institutions with no reliable internet access or budget for cloud AI subscriptions.

test_prompts.prompt: A JAMB candidate needs help: the sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression is 3n^2 + n. Find the common difference of the progression.
